n692ccc76f6.headline: Trade deficit exceeds $20 billion, Vietnam in its 'most strained' stage
n692ccc76f6.summary: Vietnam posted a trade deficit above $20 billion in the first seven months of the year. The deficit narrowed significantly in the second half of July, and an An Binh Securities analyst forecasts the trade balance will soon reverse.
n692ccc76f6.why: The trade balance affects Vietnam's currency, foreign-exchange reserves and the outlook for its export-driven manufacturing sector.

ne2f30ba0c7.why: E.SUN Financial is a Taiwanese financial holding company, and Sanshang Life is a Taiwanese life insurer that is being absorbed in the deal.

nb5909d7cd4.summary: Almost six in ten industrial workers and nine in ten construction workers have wage guarantee clauses that protect pay against inflation, according to the report.
nb5909d7cd4.why: Indexation clauses in collective wage agreements influence labour costs and how inflation passes through to company margins.

ne417cbc115.summary: Water levels on the Vistula are exceptionally low, and further record lows are possible in August and September. The drought has lasted 10 years.
ne417cbc115.why: The Vistula is Poland's largest river, and low water levels affect navigation, cooling for power plants and industrial water supply.

nd999c54c71.summary: Greek banks are expected to post record new loans, with credit expansion above 15 billion euros. Strengthening lending is presented as the key lever for sustainable bank profitability.
nd999c54c71.why: Loan growth is a core driver of net interest income for Greek lenders, which are major listed banks on the Athens exchange.

n34ead52b75.headline: Tourist arrivals in July near 2 lakh; foreign remittances rise to 777 million US dollars - ITN News
n34ead52b75.summary: Sri Lanka's gross official reserves were provisionally estimated at $6,591 million by end-July 2026. Foreign workers' remittances rose to $777 million in July, and external-sector growth was recorded.
n34ead52b75.why: Official reserves and remittance inflows are key indicators of external financing capacity, which shapes the rupee and sovereign credit assessments.

nfaf4eb99e6.headline: Small saver returns to Treasury bills and demands €15,000 million
nfaf4eb99e6.summary: Small savers are returning to Spanish Treasury bills, with demand of €15 billion reported. Inflation linked to Iran and ECB rate hikes has pushed debt yields sharply higher.
nfaf4eb99e6.why: Treasury bill yields reflect government borrowing costs and the path of ECB interest rates, which shape returns across Spanish fixed income.

n9dd04787ad.headline: Azerbaijan banks expand lending while keeping $2.7 billion liquidity cushion
n9dd04787ad.summary: Central Bank Governor Taleh Kazimov said banks are expanding lending. The sector holds excess liquidity of 6 billion manats before mandatory reserves.
n9dd04787ad.why: The central bank oversees Azerbaijan's banking system, and bank liquidity and lending levels affect credit conditions across the economy.

n19352ad848.headline: ZXMoto leads China's charge to dominate the global motorbike market
n19352ad848.summary: Chinese maker ZXMoto's superbike finished four seconds ahead of rivals in only its third world championship race, in a story on China's push to dominate the global motorbike market.
n19352ad848.why: Chongqing-based ZXMoto is a Chinese motorcycle maker; its global push matters for competition in the motorbike sector.

n25960d9e54.headline: House-hunters face spring sale shortage in market slump
n25960d9e54.summary: Weak results in major housing markets are discouraging sellers from listing properties in spring, creating a stock shortage. Prices are falling nationally across Australia.
n25960d9e54.why: Listing volumes and price trends indicate the health of the Australian housing market, which is closely linked to household wealth and bank mortgage lending.

ne9775fefb8.headline: Mcap of 4 of top-10 most valued firms jumps Rs 1.43 lakh crore; SBI biggest winner
ne9775fefb8.summary: The combined market valuation of four of India's top-10 most valued firms rose Rs 1.43 lakh crore last week, with State Bank of India the biggest gainer.
ne9775fefb8.why: State Bank of India is India's largest lender by assets, and its share price moves reflect expectations for the banking sector and the broader economy.

impacts.name: State Bank of India
impacts.why: SBI was named the biggest gainer among the top-10 firms by market valuation last week.

n694ed6a5d3.headline: Inflation numbers to bring relief for mortgage holders
n694ed6a5d3.summary: The Reserve Bank is widely tipped to keep interest rates on hold, but economists warn inflationary pressures remain, according to the report on the latest inflation numbers.
n694ed6a5d3.why: Inflation data shapes Reserve Bank decisions, which set mortgage rates for Australian households and lenders.

nbae6d7e7d1.headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
nbae6d7e7d1.summary: Wheaton Precious Metals reported record results for the first half of 2026, supported by higher commodity prices, increased sales volumes and contributions from recently added streams. The company is based in Vancouver.
nbae6d7e7d1.why: Wheaton Precious Metals is a precious metals streaming company that buys future output from mines in exchange for upfront financing, so its revenue tracks gold, silver and other metal prices.

n3c1bf51017.headline: Iran Demands U.S. Action To Reopen Strait Of Hormuz
n3c1bf51017.summary: Iran demands the US lift sanctions, withdraw military forces and pay reparations before the Strait of Hormuz reopens. Negotiations with Oman continue as recent attacks on vessels heighten regional risks.
n3c1bf51017.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major chokepoint for global seaborne oil and LNG shipments, so disruptions there feed directly into energy prices and shipping costs.

ne3f5f06c6a.headline: Meralco shares rise amid refund, cost recovery rulings
ne3f5f06c6a.summary: Shares of Manila Electric Co. rose last week and outperformed the broader market, according to analysts. The gain followed regulatory rulings on refunds and cost recovery.
ne3f5f06c6a.why: Meralco is the Philippines' largest electricity distributor, and its earnings depend heavily on regulatory decisions on tariffs and cost recovery.

n76be8435c5.headline: Iran Demands U.S. Action To Reopen Strait Of Hormuz
n76be8435c5.summary: Iran demands the US lift sanctions, withdraw military forces and pay reparations before reopening the Strait of Hormuz, as talks with Oman continue and vessels have been attacked.
n76be8435c5.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so any closure or disruption there affects crude prices and shipping costs.
n76be8435c5.why_moved: The strait's closure remains unresolved, with Iran tying reopening to US concessions and recent vessel attacks raising shipping risk.

ne2ec672686.headline: Rate hike seen despite growth slump
ne2ec672686.summary: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is expected to raise rates for a third straight time later this month to steer inflation back to target, even as growth slumped to a post-pandemic low in the second quarter.
ne2ec672686.why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is the Philippines' central bank, and its policy rate sets borrowing costs and influences the peso and local bond yields.

n261e5777d9.headline: Submarine cables in Australia, Indo-Pacific face growing attack risk: Report
n261e5777d9.summary: A new report warns that Australia and the Indo-Pacific face escalating threats to submarine cables. It urges better monitoring and repair capabilities.
n261e5777d9.why: Submarine cables carry most international internet and financial data traffic, so damage can disrupt communications and markets.

n03307eacab.headline: Will RBA boss Michele Bullock get her rates decision right?
n03307eacab.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia faces a difficult rate decision this week, with the commentary framing the choice as whether to raise rates or hold.
n03307eacab.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which drives borrowing costs, mortgage rates and the Australian dollar.

nc415a565d3.headline: Meralco to refund P0.59/kWh this month
nc415a565d3.summary: Manila Electric Co. will refund residential customers at a rate of P0.59 per kilowatt-hour this month.
nc415a565d3.why: Meralco is the Philippines' largest electricity distributor, and its refunds affect household power bills and regulated utility pricing.

ne4753efe7e.headline: IRS warns crypto investors of fake letters from fraudsters aimed at stealing wallet keys and passwords
ne4753efe7e.summary: The IRS warned of a new scam using fake letters to steal bitcoin holders' wallet keys and passwords. The alert urges investors to secure their wallets.
ne4753efe7e.why: The IRS is the US tax authority, and its scam warnings highlight security risks for holders of crypto assets such as bitcoin.

n869bf2cb78.headline: Gold, Silver Rally May Extend Next Week, Inflation Data And West Asia Tensions In Focus
n869bf2cb78.summary: Gold and silver may extend their gains next week, with investors tracking global inflation data, Fed expectations and West Asia tensions after a strong weekly rally.
n869bf2cb78.why: Gold and silver are traditional stores of value that often rise when inflation expectations, geopolitical risk or expectations of lower rates increase.

n9bdc3369d2.headline: Winter housing market slowdown becomes widespread as prices keep falling
n9bdc3369d2.summary: The winter housing market slowdown in New Zealand has become widespread, with prices continuing to fall. A few regions in both the North and South Islands are bucking the trend.
n9bdc3369d2.why: Residential property is a major share of household wealth and bank lending in New Zealand, so falling prices affect the broader economy and financial sector.

nf8516223bc.headline: India Plans FDI Policy Changes To Boost Investment & Ease Business Norms
nf8516223bc.summary: India is considering raising the threshold for FDI proposals requiring CCEA approval from Rs 5,000 crore to Rs 15,000 crore and easing some downstream investment rules.
nf8516223bc.why: Foreign direct investment rules determine how easily overseas capital can enter India, affecting project approvals and sector investment.

n5e39e0981e.headline: Burnham to promise ‘everyday fixes’ for bills at start of cost-of-living tour
n5e39e0981e.summary: The Prime Minister's summer tour on the cost of living follows his pledge to give the public breathing space on bills. He will promise everyday fixes for bills.
n5e39e0981e.why: Household energy and cost-of-living policies affect UK inflation, consumer spending and the outlook for the Bank of England.

nd824eeee76.headline: Yemen's Houthis attack Saudi refinery after kingdom signs defense pact
nd824eeee76.summary: Yemen's Houthis carried out a drone attack on Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery. The attack coincides with Saudi Arabia's new defence pact with Turkey and Pakistan amid regional instability.
nd824eeee76.why: Saudi Aramco is the state-controlled oil giant of Saudi Arabia, and attacks on its refineries can disrupt fuel supply and oil markets.

n03b6b6ae1f.headline: Prestige beauty outpaces high-end bags as China’s luxury spending evolves
n03b6b6ae1f.summary: Chinese luxury consumers are favouring prestige skincare over designer bags as a prolonged property downturn weighs on spending, according to the article.
n03b6b6ae1f.why: Luxury goods makers depend heavily on Chinese consumer demand. Shifts between product categories show how households are adjusting spending during a property slump.

n41081af599.headline: Provinces Refuse to Be Part of Govt's 1 Million Ton Wheat Import Plan
n41081af599.summary: Pakistan's plan to import up to 1 million metric tons of wheat has met resistance, with Punjab and other provincial governments reluctant to take part.
n41081af599.why: Wheat is a staple food and import decisions affect domestic prices and the government's fiscal and food-security position.

n1b19c6f037.headline: Peso may rebound after weak US payrolls report
n1b19c6f037.summary: The peso may rise against the dollar this week following weak US labor data, according to BusinessWorld.
n1b19c6f037.why: The peso's direction against the dollar affects Philippine importers, inflation and foreign investors, and it responds to US jobs data that shapes dollar strength.

nab6c35cdea.headline: Proposed higher excise taxes likely to further stall consumer spending
nab6c35cdea.summary: Analysts say the Philippines' already subdued consumer spending could face more pressure if the government raises taxes on sugary drinks, e-cigarettes and alcohol.
nab6c35cdea.why: Excise taxes raise prices on consumer goods, and weak household spending is a key driver of Philippine GDP growth.

n67c567ba59.headline: NG debt service bill increases to P77.2 billion in June
n67c567ba59.summary: The national government's debt service bill jumped in June on higher interest and amortization payments, the Bureau of the Treasury said. The bill reached P77.2 billion.
n67c567ba59.why: Debt service costs absorb government revenue and influence fiscal space and the sovereign borrowing needs that drive bond supply.

n651c589326.headline: Argentina renews US$19 billion China currency swap, brushing off Washington’s pressure
n651c589326.summary: Argentina renewed its US$19 billion yuan currency swap with China until 2031, months after the US Treasury offered a rival facility, despite pressure from Washington.
n651c589326.why: Currency swap lines provide central banks with foreign currency liquidity, which can support reserves and market confidence in countries facing external financing pressures.

n137e745559.headline: China July factory-gate inflation eases to 3-month low, CPI slows
n137e745559.summary: China's producer prices fell less steeply, reaching a three-month low in July, while consumer price inflation also slowed, according to Reuters reporting from Beijing.
n137e745559.why: China is the world's second-largest economy and a major driver of global commodity demand. Its inflation readings shape expectations for Chinese policy easing and export pricing.

n14e3c06507.headline: Before elections in UP, development roadmap of Rs 30,000 crore; CM Yogi gives green signal for construction of roads and bridges
n14e3c06507.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi approved a development roadmap for new roads, bridges and culverts at an estimated cost of about Rs 30,000 crore. MLAs submitted construction proposals for their areas.
n14e3c06507.why: Large state infrastructure programmes drive demand for construction and materials and reflect public spending priorities in India's largest state.

n6aa81300b9.summary: The Korean government is considering releasing greenbelt land in the Seoul metropolitan area, including Hanam City, as part of housing supply measures possibly announced mid-month.
n6aa81300b9.why: Greenbelt rules restrict development, so releasing land can change housing supply and property values in the Seoul area.

n61436f4f00.summary: The Ministry of Treasury and Finance will hold one auction and one direct sale tomorrow. The auction includes a 2-year fixed-coupon bond with an 18.4% coupon paid every six months.

nce24d1f93f.summary: Delayed salaries for some state employees have entered a 40th day amid a liquidity crisis. Rents, bills and debts are piling up while market activity declines.
nce24d1f93f.why: Iraq's economy depends heavily on government spending and oil revenue, so salary delays signal fiscal and liquidity stress.

nbfec79a311.headline: CPEC Phase 2.0: Governance to Boost Trade and FDI
nbfec79a311.summary: CPEC Phase 2.0 could drive industrial cooperation, technology upgrades and exports. Its success depends on Pakistan-China coordination, monitoring and policy continuity amid security and macroeconomic challenges.
nbfec79a311.why: The China-Pakistan Economic Corridor is a flagship infrastructure and investment programme linking Pakistan's economy to Chinese capital and trade.

n788a9f6bd7.headline: Korea's inflation woes grow as heat wave drives up food prices
n788a9f6bd7.summary: A prolonged summer heat wave is pushing up South Korean food prices. Officials face a possibly sharper-than-expected rebound in inflation.
n788a9f6bd7.why: Inflation trends guide the Bank of Korea's interest rate decisions, which affect Korean bond yields and the won.

nf3e48ecde0.headline: Sharp Lowers Full-Year Forecast Due to Rising Costs but Secures Net Profit; Counterattack Through AI Servers
nf3e48ecde0.summary: Sharp's first-quarter fiscal 2026 sales and profit fell due to rapid yen depreciation and higher component costs, but it still posted a net profit. It lowered its full-year forecast.
nf3e48ecde0.why: Sharp is a Japanese electronics maker with businesses in displays and electronic components. Its results are sensitive to currency moves and input costs, and it is pursuing AI server work with Hon Hai (Foxconn).

n6bdfec5a4c.summary: Tohoku Electric held an opening ceremony on July 31 for its container-type Miyagi AI Data Center, built with GetWorks. It will house next-generation GPU servers.
n6bdfec5a4c.why: Tohoku Electric is a major Japanese regional utility, and data centers are a growing source of electricity demand driven by AI computing. Its expansion into hosting services shows utilities moving into digital infrastructure.

n351ca62c06.headline: Red Sea: Houthis claim attack on oil refinery
n351ca62c06.summary: The Houthis, backed by Iran, claim to have shelled a Saudi oil refinery. The report follows a Sunni military pact Saudi Arabia concluded with NATO member Turkey and Pakistan.
n351ca62c06.why: Attacks on Saudi refining infrastructure threaten crude and refined product supply, which can lift global oil prices.
n351ca62c06.why_moved: A claimed strike on a major Saudi oil refinery raises the risk of supply disruption, which typically lifts oil prices.

n23487bcd17.headline: RIGI Already Moves Nearly US$47 Billion but Still Has No Impact on the Economy
n23487bcd17.summary: Projects under the RIGI regime already account for nearly US$47 billion, but the economic effect remains limited. Companies accelerated imports recently, and extractive sectors hold a growing share of foreign investment.
n23487bcd17.why: RIGI is Argentina's incentive regime for large investment projects, aimed at attracting foreign capital. Its scale relative to the economy shapes views on the country's growth and external financing.
